:::{#rem-prediction-error}
#### The prediction error of a prediction function

A [prediction function](#def-prediction-function) $\predfn$ makes the [prediction](#def-prediction) $\predfnf{\Predvar}$
for the [outcome](#def-outcome) $\Outvar$ of a [new observation](#def-new-observation) with [input](#def-input) $\Predvar$.
We write $\prederrf{\predfn}$ for the [prediction error](#def-prediction-error) of that prediction,
meaning $\prederrf{\predfnf{\Predvar}}$,
which is

$$\prederrf{\predfn} = \predfnf{\Predvar} - \Outvar$$

The reference value in a prediction error is the observed outcome $\Outvar$,
not the [conditional mean](#def-cond-expectation-function) of that outcome.

:::
